Happy to help with that. What's your order number, and either the name on the order or the email you used?
Order Shop···· confirmed

Thanks. I just need one detail that matches the order to pull it up: the email on it, or the name it ships to.
Name: Al
Looked something up in Shopify
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill

Got it, Al. Your order is the Magic Miner 40T plus the Harlo OS diagnostics, nothing shipped yet, and it ships October 31.

Before we go to a cancellation, can I ask what changed? If it's the wait, one option is store credit for the full amount you paid, on your account straight away, so you can use it whenever you like without losing your spot on price.

Tell me what's behind it and I'll sort it either way.
Its room space, currently its a bit hot here in middle east.
Read the nexus s1 10th s page
Read the magic miner 40t page

Makes sense, Riyadh in summer is no joke. Two things before we cancel.

The 40T is smaller than people expect, 33 x 16.5 x 19 cm, so it sits on a shelf. And it's tunable: Eco mode runs 30 TH/s at 450W instead of 650W, which is a lot less heat in the room, and it's around 50 dB.

If that still doesn't work for your space, I can swap it to a smaller, lower-power unit instead. Want me to look at what's available for your region?
What i can say for now is this cancelation is temporary, i need the funds. But yeah still looking forward for bigger hashrate with minimal noise.
Handed to the team · refund and cancellation need a person to process

Understood, Al, if you need the funds then that's the right call. Nothing has shipped, it's a pre-order, so it cancels in full with no restocking fee.

Abel or Georges have been pinged and will jump into this chat to process it and confirm. Stay with me here if you can, and if you step away the confirmation comes to your email.

When you're ready to come back, tell me the room and I'll pick the quietest unit for the hashrate you want.
Thanks Sarah, I leave for now and just wait for the email confirmation.
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: what made you pick the 40T over the smaller miners when you ordered?
First the hashrate, second was gonna pick bsb30 but JD says he will pick 40T. So yeah thats pretty it
Got it. When you come back to it, what counts as quiet enough for the room you'd put it in?
Id say aroud 50db max
That's noted, thanks Al. Watch your inbox for the confirmation, and come find me when you're ready to look again.
I will, thank you again.
Anytime, Al. Take care, and good luck with the heat over there.
